head: b36e84f
note: Desktop frontend packages. apps/desktop is the app shell; apps/web is a browser re-export of the same App via @desktop alias. frontend/packages are shared TS source packages (workspace: frontend/package.json workspaces packages/*).

packages.name: windagent-desktop
packages.purpose: Tauri 2 + React 18 desktop app. Own vite/vitest config. The ONLY app bundle that loads the full UI.

packages.name: windagent-web
packages.purpose: Browser-targeted Vite app. App.tsx re-exports desktop App via alias @desktop -> ../desktop/src. Its own src/clients/* + src/state/state_recovery.ts are NOT imported by the app (only by their own tests) - dead leftovers of a Phase-13 web app.

packages.name: @windagent/production-contracts
packages.purpose: TS types + routing codecs for the production workspace (project, revision, screenplay, commands, events).

packages.name: @windagent/production-client
packages.purpose: ProductionApiClient interface + HttpProductionApiClient (/api/v2/video-production/*) + FakeProductionApiClient (in-memory proj-alpha/proj-beta) + ProductionSyncClient.
packages.notes: HttpProductionApiClient.listProjects() hardcodes getProject('vp_001'). Fake client used by ProductionWorkspacePage; Http client has ZERO app callers.
packages.roadmap_1_status: PRESERVE/ISOLATE (fake client is the desktop wiring today)

packages.name: @windagent/production-platform
packages.purpose: ProductionPlatformAdapter port + adapters: TauriDesktopAdapter (file dialog), BrowserWebAdapter, FakeTestAdapter, DesktopStorageRecoveryAdapter, WebStorageRecoveryAdapter.

packages.name: @windagent/production-state
packages.purpose: Redux Toolkit store: projectContextSlice, screenplaySlice, bindingSlice, recoverySlice, useUnsavedChangesGuard.
packages.notes: No app importer found (tests only) - dead export until a production screen mounts it.

packages.name: @windagent/production-ui
packages.purpose: ProductionShell (project switcher + 3 module tabs) + rich screenplay/collaboration/conflict/recovery component suite + 3 placeholders (ScriptEditorPlaceholder, AssetLibraryPlaceholder, VideoWorkspacePlaceholder).
packages.notes: ProductionShell renders the 3 PLACEHOLDERS; ScreenplayWorkspaceView, StructuredEditor, SceneTree, SceneInspector, ConflictResolverModal, SemanticDiffViewer etc. are exported but imported by NOTHING outside tests (dead exports, TEST_ONLY). ProductionHeader gets hardcoded syncStatus='synced' backendStatus='online'.

packages.name: @windagent/studio-contracts
packages.purpose: Frozen studio.contract/v0.1 TS types generated from JSON schemas (series, episode, episode-state, artifact-envelope, run-resource, run-status, error-payload, approval-mode, idempotency-headers, rabbit-kite-scenario) + fixtures. Scripts: generate-contracts.mjs, check-drift.mjs.

packages.name: @windagent/studio-client
packages.purpose: HttpStudioApiClient - real HTTP client for /api/v3/studio. Idempotency key required on mutations, 15s timeout, typed StudioApiError/StudioNetworkError/StudioTimeoutError, GET retry once.

packages.name: @windagent/studio-state
packages.purpose: StudioStore - class-based server-authority state/query layer: Maps for series/episodes/runs/artifacts, capabilities, pending-command markers, run polling (2s interval, cursor from server next_after), sessionStorage cursor hydration, error classification.

packages.name: story-ui
packages.purpose: Roadmap 1 target package for story workflow UI components.

packages.name: studio-shell
packages.purpose: Roadmap 1 target package for the Studio shell/layout.
